    Simple tops of indecomposable projective modules #

    The original simple module S_x = P_x / rad P_x of a projective label (graded-category.tex) and the identity dim Hom_A(P_y, S_x) = δ_{xy} used in the proof of Proposition 2.10. The code adapts general module theory from the magnitude-conjecture formalization (Algebra/RightModuleSimpleTop.lean and Algebra/RightModuleBasicSimpleDimension.lean), stated here for an IndSkeleton.
